_description: Machine-readable mix plan produced by lib/audio/build-mix-plan.ts. Consumed by render-final-mix.ts and validate-final-mix.ts.

music_file.description: Filename only — not an absolute path. Runtime resolves the full path from --music arg.

voice_occupancy_intervals.description: Seconds where narration voice is expected. Ducking is applied in these regions.

intentional_silence_intervals.description: Declared silence windows. Music may surface slightly. Not accidental gaps.

music_gain_envelope.description: Gain automation relative to music_initial_gain_db. Stored for documentation and manual mixing. FFmpeg render uses the sidechain ducking approach from lib/audio-mixing.ts.

music_initial_gain_db.description: Layer 2 under Layer 1 voice per NDCH_017_MASTERING_PRESET.

ducking_filter.description: FFmpeg sidechaincompress parameters for voice-aware music ducking.

ending_behavior.note: Möbius law requires hard_cut. Do not change to fade_out without explicit doctrinal reason.

non_destructive_law.music_file: Contains filename only. Absolute path is never stored in committed artifacts.
